I made no new edits this turn. `finish_bim` re-selected `candidate_01`, and the viewer is at `candidate_01/viewer.html`. I recorded a stop decision on that basis, and drawing fidelity is still marked "not evaluated".

**What the saved candidate covers**
- **Geometry:** It has 8 spaces, 21 openings and 10 connections, and the source validation passes. In the earlier pass I overlaid it on `1f_view.png` and saw no substantive mismatch.
- **Space relations:** 4 point-pair samples all agree with the source. They cover only the pairs I chose.
- **Room uses:** Each of the 8 spaces has a recorded use basis. Seven uses are inferred from furniture symbols and one, `F1_S04`, stays unknown. `F1_S05` is tentative.
- **Opening heights:** I compared them by eye with the four elevation drawings and found them consistent. None of the 21 openings has a height claim linked to the drawings, so this is a visual check only. Interior doors remain at an assumed 2.1 m.

**Still open**
- **Calibration:** The pixel-to-world calibration is my own and was not independently verified.
- **Interior doors:** I did not re-measure their positions or swings.
- **Elevation-to-plan matching:** It rests on dimension chains only.
- **Reviews:** The opening and facade review scopes are all "not reviewed".

I judged the remaining items to be small refinements, so I stopped rather than make edits with no new evidence behind them.
